buffeting winds|air.synergy: 1-minute chokepoint that stacks difficult terrain with severe ranged-attack banes and grounds flyers; locks down entire engagement zones.

evoke gale|air.synergy: Cone knockback scatters clustered enemies and strips fog or gas, removing enemy concealment and disrupting tight formations.

explosive exhalation|air.synergy: Stun on success lets allies pile on with boon attacks the same round; secondary damage makes it efficient even on a miss of the stun.

flense|air.synergy: Execute finisher that instakills incapacitated targets; pair with Health-reduction debuffs to trigger the threshold on tougher foes.

glide|air.synergy: Hold in reserve whenever allies risk falling; pairs naturally with knockback spells or verticality-heavy terrain to nullify fall lethality.

heat wave|air.synergy: Fatigued condition forces banes on attack rolls across a group; softens multiple enemies at once before a sustained fight.

shimmering wall|air.synergy: Position allies behind the line to impose 2 banes on incoming ranged attacks; stack with other ranged-denial effects for a hard firing lane.

still the air|air.synergy: Silence enemy spellcasters or block sound-based spells entirely; 1-hour duration supports pre-encounter prep before ambushes or sieges.

stir the air|air.synergy: Soft ranged-deterrent for melee builds that also clears smoke or fog while moving, denying enemies obscurement cover.

uplifting step|air.synergy: Lets melee builds bypass difficult terrain and environmental gaps to stay on top of kiting targets or reach backline enemies.

wind blast|air.synergy: Knockback plus prone on a crit; push enemies off ledges, break formations, or create separation to protect fragile allies.

wind disk|air.synergy: Defense bonus plus ranged-bane aura; Shield Disk extends coverage to nearby allies, making it a versatile anchor for Will-based tanks.
